61)bka' drin che phra du mas bskyangs ba'i rang gi bla ma rnams kyi mtshan byang*/mgon chos rje sangs rgyas dngos 'dra rnams/ /yid ma bcos snying nas dung du

tei:div.tei:p: bka' drin che phra du mas bskyangs ba'i rang gi bla ma rnams kyi mtshan byang*/ mgon chos rje sangs rgyas dngos 'dra rnams// yid ma bcos snying nas dung dung dran// ban ser sgor dang po lam bstan pa// rje 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse snying nas dran// skra sor gsum bzhes nas thabs mkhas kyis// sems chos kyi phyogs la bskor ba dang*// las mi dge'i phyogs las bsrings pa dang*// sdom gsum gyi sdom pa thog mar byin// rje chos kyi nyi ma snying nas dran// gsang sngags kyi dbang bskur byin nas kyang*// thar pa yi sa bon bzhag mdzad pa// rje blo gros mtha' yas snying nas dran// sems dang po nang du bskor la bslabs// rje sna tshogs rang grol snying nas dran// thub dbang gi bka' lung byin mdzad cing*// sngags gsar ma'i dbang bskur gnang mdzad pa// rje bkra shis chos 'phel snying nas dran// tshig re zung bkrol nas don la dkris// thos bsam la dang po kha bskor ba// rje 'jam dpal rdo rje snying nas dran// mdo sngags kyi gzhung lugs mang po bslabs// smin grol gyi bdud rtsi'i chos char phab// rje rgyal mtshan 'od zer snying nas dran// sde snod kyi gzhung la dbye mdzad pa// rje kun bzang dpal ldan snying nas dran// thugs brtse bas dgongs te byin gyis rlobs/ 62) /rje mi pham rgya mtsho snying nas dran// gdams ngag gi bdud rtsi ston mor 'gyed// rje bkra shis 'od zer snying nas dran// bsil ldan ljongs mchis so 'tshal kun gyi// man ngag gi mdzod chen pha phogs byin// rje chos kyi rgya mtsho snying nas dran// snying tig gi bka' gsang ma lus byin// rje shes rab bzang po snying nas dran// sngags lam gyi mig 'byed dngos grub ster// rje dri med 'od zer snying nas dran// thugs gsang gi smin byed dbang bskur byin// rje dbang mchog rgyal po snying nas dran// sgrub thabs kyi dngos grub byin mdzad pa// rje phrin las dbang sgyur snying nas dran// gnas lugs kyi rang zhal mngon sum bstan// yid dpyod dang blos byas ma reg pa'i// ye shes kyi gzigs pa sgrib med brnyes// gzhan phan gyi bsam bzang byin mdzad cing*// bka' drin stong gsum rin chen bdun// skal bzang bas phul kyang gsab mtha' bral// mtshan brjod na ba spu mchi ma gzing*// tshe rabs nas las kyi 'phro rnyed pa// rje ngag gi dbang po snying nas dran// gso dpyad kyi rigs pa sbyin par mdzad// rje tshul khrims rgyal mtshan snying nas dran// skar rtsis kyi gzhung dang rig pa bslabs// dge mkhyen rab nor bu'i bka' drin dran// sgra rig pa'i snang ba 'byed mdzad pa// rje tshe dbang rgya mtsho'i bka' drin dran/

63) /yon tan gyi gzhi rten dpe klog bslabs// kun spyod kun gtsang mar 'dom mdzad pa// pha ma las lhag par drin gyi skyong*// rje tshul khrims rnam dag snying nas dran// gre ba yi rigs la thog mar bslabs// rje sngags btsun don 'grub bkra shis dran// lung nye bar mkho ba'i bka' drin byin// dge ba'i bshes yon tan khyad par 'phags// rje shes rab rgya mtsho snying nas dran// pha chos kyi snying khrag lta bu byin// rje pad+ma theg mchog snying nas dran// lugs gnyis kyis bka' drin tshad med skyong*// rgyal ba'i sras byang chub sems dpa' dngos// rje pad+ma rgyal mtshan snying nas dran// 'jam dpal gyi smin byed byin rlabs thob// rje 'jam dpal blo gros snying nas dran// bde ba can smon lam 'brel pa bzhag /rje pad+ma bde chen snying nas dran// bka' brgyad kyi lung dang lag len bslabs// rje dpal ldan don 'grub snying nas dran// mdos yas kyi dpe sogs lung yang byin// rje pad+ma rnam rgyal snying nas dran// sngags lam gyi rig pa cung zad bkral// rje karma tshe dpal snying nas dran/ rje gu ru'i gsung rab tshem zung thob/ khyung po ba rin chen phyag gi gnas// rje mi pham zhabs kyis gsung tshem thob// mgon pad+ma gnyis kyang phyag gi gnas// kī la ya'i rgyud bshad bklag lung nos/ 64) /rje chos grags mtshan kyang phyag gi gnas// rje mi pham pa yi gsung tshem nos// mched chos dpal rgya mtsho snying nas dran// bla sgrub ni tshem pa'i chos 'brel thob// sprul pad+ma rgyal mtshan phyag gi gnas/ gzhung kha shas bskyar sbyong bka' drin nos// bsam brtan dang skal bzang phyag gi gnas// mtsho dbus ma'i gsol 'debs chos 'brel thob// rje theg mchog rdo rje snying nas dran// rtogs pa nas rgyun ma chad pa yi// rgyun rnam dag gzhung rigs bka' drin skyong*// mi bdag gi bla mar gyur pa rnams// sku rnam pa mchog dman ltar shar yang*// don rgyal ba'i sprul par the tshom med// bka' drin skyong che chung gi mos zhen dang*// dad 'dun la che chung cung zad yod// de yod kyang snyan grags rjes su min// rang rgyud bka' drin che chung gis// mos 'dun ma de mtshungs bya ba ni// rje dpal ldan jo bo rje yis bzhed// don de slad bdag gi lus ngag yid// 'di phyi kun sgrib pa'i nongs pa kun// mgon thugs rje can la bzod par gsol// de dag pa'i dbang mchog dngos grub zhu// sgo gsum gyi bya ba chos mthun rnams/

mgon skyabs gnas rnams kyi spyan snga ru// mchod pa'i sprin rgya mtshor sprul nas 'bul// chos sku rnams dgongs pa rdzogs pa dang*/ 65) /gzugs sku yis thugs rjes dgongs nas kyang*// zhabs pad mo rdo rje ltar brtan zhing*// byang chub bar 'bral med rjes 'dzin shog /rang ngos kyi bla ma gsang nas kyang*// mtshan snyan grags gang che bla mar 'dzin// de 'dra bas las ngan tshabs chen gsog /don de slad bla ma'i mtshan nas bsngags// bsngags na sngags go chod pa yod// rta mig ni lcags kyi matums nas ni// 'dzam gling kun btsal kyang nga'i bla ma/ 'di 'dra ba nges par rnyed dka' bsam/ ༈ skyabs bka' drin mtshungs bral bslu ba med/ rje ngag gi dbang po'i zhabs la 'dud/ chos med kyi sprang po chos glang nga*// las ci la bsam kyang sems re skyo// byis pa nas dar la ma babs bar// dgon gog pa'i zhabs zhu yin snyam gyis// dkor grong chog nyin mtshan sbrel ma byas// rta drel gyi sug pa rdo la brdungs// rgyab glo dang rnga rtsa phal cher zad// 'dir snang gi bya ba rngams chen la/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa yin mdog gis// mgo g.yogs de mi tshe phal cher zad// las ngan gyi bsags rdob ha cang drag /shi gson 'bum phrag mang po dang*// rgyu nor 'brel pas ma bsdus med// 'brel tshad kun 66)don ldan skyes bu yi/ stangs ka 'dis ngan song las 'gro sa med// der ma zad rang rgyud la spyad tsa na// gzhi so sor thar pa'i sdom nos kyang*// gdong skya skya'i ngo yi phrogs nas thal// rgyal sras kyi lam la zhugs na yang*// rgyud khong khro 'dis ni shul med btang*// sngags kyi dbang bskur zhus na yang*// dag snang de gar yin ngo ma shes// tha mal gyi 'khrul rtog kho na las// chos mthun gyi lam bden skye ma myong*// bcos bcos kyang ba rgan gyang ngos la// ded pa bzhin ci byed thabs dang bral// rje bla ma ngag dbang dpal bzang pos// thugs brtse ba chen pos rjes bzung nas// sngon 'gro nas dngos gzhi mthar phyin bar// thob thob yang da ni brjed nas song*/

nyams len ni sne mo'i rgyud ma 'byor// de sngon yan 'grub pa ci 'dug na// sos dal gyi stong 'dug nyin mo byed// mtshan nam gzhung gti mug gnyid la brtson// ngag 'khyal gyi gtam nyob mang po bshad// grogs su dang 'grogs kyang chags sdang byas// yar bla ma rnams la phyogs zhen gyis// dga' mi dga'i bstod smad sna tshogs byas// zhe ma dga'i bla ma bzang na yang*// rdzun pa sogs bskur 'debs gang rung byas// pho mo yi 'dris rogs mang po btsal/ 67) /'dris rnying tshad rnams dang rgyang rgyang byas// mi rgyus med rnams dang gsar 'dris byas/ khas bshad dus bden bden 'dra mo byas// lag len dus mun pa rub rub byas// sdom dam tshig thams cad chu la 'phos// da bsam na bslab pa sne gcig med// nga las sdug 'jig rten khams na med// med ngo ma rgyal khams bskor dang gsal// de e bden rang la mdzub mo tshugs// gdong mchi mas mi gang pa 'di ci/ khyod ngo lcags 'bag las byas pa 'dra// las rgyu 'bras bslu ba med nges pa// tshe phyi ma'i pha yul dmyal ba yin// gshin rje yi skyes dang 'phrad dus su/ khyo'i lcags 'bag de de dus e snang lta// rje rdo rje 'chang chen mi gzugs can// pha bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// sprang chos gzugs 'chang ba'i btsun chung bdag /blo chos su 'gro bar byin gyis rlobs// gnas gang du bsdad kyang skyo ba 'phel// grogs su dang 'grogs kyang skyo ba 'phel// las ji ltar byas kyang skyo ba 'phel// bdag rang gi rang la skyo ba 'phel// nyams dman zhing ri sul sdod pa la// 'jig rten gyi mthun 'jug mi shes shing*// gtam kha sgo zhan 68) cing blo sna thung*// gnas gcig pur mi tshugs khams 'dus che// bshad pa dang rdzogs chen gyi chos lugs byed// dgon chus kyi mgo 'dzin mi byed ces// de skad smra ba kun kyang med// 'jig rten gyi mthun 'jug ngo srung 'di// byas na ni mi shes med mod kyi// tshe 'di gang sgrub na phyi ma brlag

khab rtse gnyis kyi bzo drub mi 'ong ltar// chos 'jig rten mnyam por sgrub pa ni// rje shākya'i rgyal pos ma 'grub na// bdag lta bus 'grub pa lta ci smros// de'i phyir na chos sgor zhugs pa 'di// 'di gang gi don du ma lags pas// tshe phyi ma'i gtan srid sgrub pa la// 'jig rten gyi mthun 'jug med kyang legs// 'jig rten gtam gyi kha sgo 'di// bshad na ni mi thon med mod kyang*// don med kyi 'chal gtam gung bsgrigs 'di// mi dge bcu nang ngag 'khyal nyid// gtam kha sgo dgra gyod bshad dus mkho// chos byang chub sgrub dus mi mkho bas// ngag 'khyal gyi kha sgo med kyang legs// blo ring po khog yangs skor ba 'di// tshe mi rtag blo la ma byang rtag /le lo dang mtshungs ldan khog rgya ni// chos byang chub sgrub pa'i bar chad che// rgyu 'bras des blo sna thung na legs/ 69)/gnas gcig tu yun ring sdod pa la// a gsar gyis dang po lha ru blta// mthong na ni dad pa'i spu long byed// gshibs che na mnyam por 'dra 'dra lta// brnyas bcos kyi khyi phag 'dra bar byed// 'dris ran dus bltas na mthong ba'i dug /phung rgan dang yor rgan gyis smod pa'i gzhi// rgyu de bas ma 'dris gsar 'grogs dus// chags sdang gi gzhi ma ma gnang rogs// gnas nges med sdod sa spos na legs/ khams 'dus pa don med ma yin te// dus snyigs ma'i chos pa gzugs ltar rnams// tshe 'di gang gi bsam pas khog bzung nas// chos kha la bshad rgyus chog chags byed// bsam bzang zhig rgyud la ma skyes pa'i// chos gzugs brnyan mthong nas khams 'di 'dus/ dgon chen tshos lung rtogs bstan pa ni// gar yin tsam snang la ma nges pa/ khang khyim dang rgyu nor gang bzang 'brel/ dbyangs rol dang 'bag 'cham gsang sgrog rigs// sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa yin no zhes// bstan pa dang gzugs brnyan nor ba la/

khams 'dus rgyu yod na 'dus re ran// bsnyen bskyed rdzogs pas sdom pa mnos nas ni// ngo skya skya'i bud med mthong na ni// de la spyad nas kha pho ngom/ 70) /nyes pa'i tshogs kun gyi rtsa ba ni// myos 'gyur gyi chang la bag med 'thung*/ kha zas la nyes pa med do zhes// sangs rgyas la rgyab kyi phyogs par byed// skyon la yon tan mthong ba la/ khams 'dus rgyu yod na 'dus re ran// phan byed kyi kha ta dam pa'i chos// rdzun med kyi bden pa bshad pa'i tshe// brda ma 'phrod go log bzung nas ni// don log pa 'di skad bshad do ces// chos bshad mkhan la phya dang skur pa 'debs// rang skyon dang gzhan skyon mi shes pa'i// gnas 'di 'dra mthong nas khams 'di 'dus// mtshan nyid kyi gzhung la bshad pa 'di// lung rtogs kyi bstan pa'i lung gi chos// rdzogs chen bstan la bya ba 'di// lung rtogs gnyis las rtogs pa'i chos// lung rtogs kyi bstan pa gnyis po 'di// sngar kun bzang shes rab sogs kyis bzung*// pha rjes bu yis bzung nas ni// rnying dgon gyi ming thogs 'di nyid la// bshad sgrub bstan pa yod na yang*// snying po dam pa ma lags so// thams cad kun lung rtogs bstan pa la// blo ma babs bsam pa ma bde na// dgon chus kyi mgo 'dzin chen po 'di/ khyim chung spang ba'i khyim chen zhes// rgyal po kri kra'i rmi lam du// glang po che lus thon mjug ma thon// lung bstan de 71)dus thog babs pa yin// 'go 'dzin gyi bya ba khong khro 'dis// tshe 'di gang phung la phyi mar phung*// bdag rang nyid sa 'dir mi sdod dang*// shel sgong dang ni shel 'od bzhin// bdag gis rjes su 'gro ba las// bshad dang rdzogs chen lta ba'i chos// shul du dri tsam lus pa yi// dgos pa gtan nas mi dgos so// chos byang chub grub pa'i skal ba chad// ngan song ni mu mtha' med par 'gro// 'phags pa yi gang zag thams cad kyis// dge 'dun gyi las byed ma skye zhes// smon lam btab pa'i mthar thug yin// sde dgon gyi mgo 'dzin zhi drag gi

khur thang che bar blang ba de// tshe 'dir yang mi 'dod thog tu 'bab// 'dod kun thog tu mi 'bab sogs/ khur thang gis khur gyis lus sems non// tshe phyi mar ma byas dang mi 'phrad// byas pa chud ni mi za bas// rang byas kyis las ni rang nyid las/ gzhan du sprad pa med mod na// phyi ma'i khur thang de bas che// tshe 'dir yang khur gyis mi bde la// phyi mar khur gyis des mi bde// mi bde ba yi khur thang la// bros na da res bros re ran// rgyal khams kun pha yul yin pa la// 'gro sa med do bsam mi dgos// skye 'gro kun mdza' shes yin pa la/ 72) /gnyen gshes med do bsam mi dgos// mi med kyi lung stong skyid pa ru// bshes med rig pa'i grogs dang 'grogs// bla ma dkon mchog ma rtogs pa'i// tsha zhang yin kyang blo mi gtod// sna thag rang gi mgo la dkris// rang thag rang gi bcad pa la// dang po skyes kyang gcig pur skyes// tha ma 'chi yang gcig pur 'chi// da lta gnas dus grogs gang dgos// sdod tshugs na rang mgo chos kyis bton// zol zog gi bya ba spongs la 'dug /sdod ma bcug gar 'gro pha yul yin// mtshan ldan bla ma bstan zhing 'gro// zab dgu'i gdams pa nyan zhing 'gro// mi dge'i grogs rnams spong zhing 'gro// thar pa'i lam dang 'grogs shing 'gro// 'khrul pa'i snang ba rtogs zhing 'gro// dag pa'i zhing khams blta ru 'gro// sgyu ma'i 'khrul 'khor bshig cing 'gro// 'gro na 'gro lugs de ltar lags// kun rtog 'khrul pa'i snang ba la// 'gog med dgra 'di lam gyis shar// shar ba ltar du bris nas bzhag /dga' na dge ba gzhan la bsngo// sdug na sdug bsngal rgya mtsho skem// las ngan gyi rgyun thag chad nas kyang*// srid pa'i mtsho las sgrol bar shog ༈ ring nas bshibs 'dris snying gi grogs po che// ngos na bdag la 73)bla ma'i yon tan ci// dge ba'i grogs tsam 'gyur ba'i yon tan med// 'on kyang khyed dang a dkar gnyis po ni// dge ba'i bshes kyis gong ma ma yin kyang*// las kyi dbang gi rang dang 'brel 'dris che/

kha bshad tshig skam gang shes gab sbas med// nga la des lhag bshad rgyu med mod kyang*// nga yi bshes cig ngag gi dbang po bzhugs// nga yi grogs ni mgon des thugs rjes 'dzin// mgo btags gcig chog lo ba'i bla ma yin// 'jig rten 'di na grags can mang na yang*// chos dang mthun pa kho bo'i bla ma tsam// de la sten dang 'di phyir bslu mi srid// de phyir snying sdug rang gi ma bslu dang*// chos dang bla mas mi bslu kho thag chod// mi tshe ril po pha yul sdod 'dun spongs/ kho bo'i bla ma mchog sprul sten gyis dang*// zas gos phongs pa mi 'byung kho thag chod// sngon byon dam pa'i rnam thar los kyang zin// yon mdzod tshig gi 'grel pa nges par dka'// kho bo blo rmongs gti mug snyom las che// de 'dra'i spobs pa phra bas cir mi btub// bla rgyud bla rnam gsar 'bri bya ba la// dgos med nus med byin rlabs med pa yi// nyab nyob mang po mkho bya gang yang med/ 'don na 74) bla sgrub thig le'i rgya can thon// de la brgyud rim tsam ni yod dgos na// chos zad ma bcos ngag gi dbang*// zhi 'dzum paṇ+ḍi ta yi chas// phyag g.yas ral gri g.yon pusti// spyi gtsug 'ja' zer thig le'i klong*// lung rtogs bstan pa'i nyi ma ni// bī ma la yi ngo bor bzhugs// de yi dbu gtsug nas yas rim// o rgyan 'jigs med chos kyi dbang*// rgyal ba'i myu gu 'jigs med gling*// gdod ma'i mgon po klong chen pa// sems nyid ngal bso'i phyag rgya dang*/

sbrel/ ༈ grogs kyi mchog gyur bde chen lags// grong dang dgon pa ri sul gang du yang*// sdod pa'i tshe na mnyam bzhag spros bral ba/ yengs med dran pas gtad med ngang du skyongs// spyod lam kun tu blang dor mi brjed pa'i// dran shes rtsis zin nam yang brjed mi nyan// bla ser tshogs pa mchog dman su mthong yang*// rang skyon blta ba'i me long shes byas nas// yon tan can mthong de la spro sems dang*// de rjes slob par 'dod pa'i bsam pa dran// skyon can mthong na rang gi mig skyon yin// gzhan la 'di 'dra'i skyon yod ga la srid// bsam nas rang skyon ngos bzung dman sa 'dzin// nam yang thon snang shes snang mi byed par/ 75) /rang skyon dgra 'di mgo nas ji non gces// shes mkhan thon mkhan zer ba dka' mo yin// thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang ma thob bar// rgyal sras rnams la'ang shes sgrib yod gsungs na// rang re so skyes ci yang shes pa dkon// nangs snga 'chi yang de ring rig pa slobs// bslab rgyu sbyang rgyu byed la ngo mi tsha// ma shes o zob sdod pa mtha' chad yin// nam yang sbyang la rtog dpyod byas pa de// ja tshe re yang brjed mi shor ba gnad// dpyod dang dpyod dang mtho snang khengs dregs med// dpyod dang rang skyon mi mthong mi srid do// dpyod dang rang gi rang la mi gsal med// a khu bde chen rtog dpyod rgyun du gyis// zhes pa 'ang a dkar bde chen gyis bskul ngor pad+ma nor bus so// ༈ gson dang yid kyi chu skyes bzhad par// sbra ma ra bzhin rtag tu brtse ba'i// ba su bar+dha'i ming gi brgyan pa'i// btsun chung sna bo che khyod nyon dang*// chos bzhin spyod pa'i dal 'byor rin chen// da ran tsam la rnyed pa ma yin// dam pa'i chos kyi rnyed pa don ldan// dgos pa gcig pu snying la bcang dgos// ding sang mi rnams gya gyu can las// drang po byed pa su yang med pas// gzhan la ci mos

76)blta ba'i tshig las// ci dran gang dran kha ru ma smra// smra ba mang po gyod kyi gzhi ma// smras tshad thams cad rtsod pa'i gzhi las// nam yang med pa kun tu ngag sdoms// rang gi khur thang rang la yod pas// mchog dman bar ma su dang gang la// mdza' yang mi dgos 'khon yang mi dgos// sngar 'dris rnying pa yal bar ma dor// gsar 'dris shag po mang po ma tshol// 'dris tshad kun yang mdza' bos skyong dgos// rgyu rdzas byin res bya rgyu med kyang*/ kha yi ngo srung la sogs byed dgos// 'dris tshad thams cad grogs po ma byed// gzhan la skad cha 'jam po smra las// tshig rtsub 'dra ba nam yang ma zer// gzhan de mthur mgo byed nas 'gro yang*// ma red bsam nas sems ma bab kyang*// ma red zer ba'i tshig de ma smra// yag yag khyod khyod bzang bzang gyis dang*// thams cad rna lam lhan gyi bud 'gro// ma red zer ba'i khur thang med pas// ma zer ma zer a bu bu lu// zer na gzhan gyi sems la phog 'gro// khong khro slong la dgos pa med pas// mchog dman drag zhan 'dris dang ma 'dris// su dang su yang spro langs ma 'jug kha yi tshig 77)gis 'jam po shod dang*/ kha ni mi zad ngo ma yin pas/ kha yi 'jam po bshad rgyu ma chugs// sems kyi dran tshad kha ru ma smra/ kha yi smras tshad lag tu ma len// de rnams nyon dang a bu'i snying sdug ces rang slob nor 'phel la gdams pa thub bstan chos kyi glang pos bris pa dge'o// maṅga laṃ// 78)
